We are the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We're training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
 The role 
You'll lead marketing operations and analytics at Cohere. That covers the team, the martech stack, how we measure marketing's contribution to pipeline, and the budget and pipeline numbers marketing plans against. When leadership asks what marketing produced last quarter and what to fund next, the answer starts with your numbers.
The role reports to the VP of Brand. You'll work most closely with the Marketing Chief of Staff and the heads of Growth and Demand and Product Marketing, and every week with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations & Finance. Web operations is part of marketing but doesn't report to this role.
 The team 
You'll manage the marketing operations, automation, and analytics and data operations staff, and hire where you find gaps. Marketing is growing rapidly, so you'll also bring acquired companies' systems and data into our stack.
 Measurement 
The attribution methodology is yours, documented and signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. Each quarter you'll present marketing's pipeline contribution to the executive team and say what you'd change. Your analysts do the same for the program teams in Growth and Demand, Events and Product Marketing, showing which campaigns and channels are paying back their spend.
 Systems and data 
Marketo, Looker, GA4 and 6sense are yours end-to-end, along with the campaign and lead side of Salesforce. That includes forms, nurture, lead lifecycle, scoring and routing. Campaign data needs to be structured well enough that analysts don't need workarounds, and target-account data has to reconcile to the governed account list. With Revenue Operations, you'll make sure the data behind marketing's pipeline numbers can't change without a record, so a bulk edit can't quietly rewrite marketing's results. A/B testing on nurture and forms sits with you too, sized so the results can be read.
Over time we want fewer tools and fewer dashboards, with one governed source for each metric.
 Budget and planning numbers 
You'll own the martech and operations budget and track budget and headcount across marketing. You'll also build the pipeline and capacity models marketing plans against. The Marketing Chief of Staff runs planning and the business reviews and leads the trade-off conversations with your numbers in hand. Marketing and Sales need to count pipeline the same way, every time.
 Your first year 
In the first 90 days, you'll document the attribution methodology and get it signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. By then we should also have an inventory of every reporting surface, each with a named owner, and your order for fixing the data problems you inherit.

This is a genuinely rare role sitting at the intersection of AI engineering, revenue operations, and go-to-market strategy — a trifecta that is commanding increasing market premiums in 2024–2025. "GTM Architect" or "GTM Engineer" titles are emerging as some of the fastest-growing roles in B2B SaaS, and early movers building this skillset are well-positioned.
 Compensation context: The base range of CAD $110k–$140k (OTE up to $155k) is competitive for a senior IC role at a Canadian tech company, though it trails comparable US-based roles by 20–30%. The LTIP is a meaningful differentiator for a ~20-year-old profitable company.
Agentic AI workflow design using LLMs, MCP connectors, and tools like n8n — highly transferable and in short supply.
Signal-based GTM strategy (product-led growth meets AI-driven outbound) — a rapidly maturing discipline.
SQL-backed revenue analytics tied directly to business outcomes (renewals, NRR, LTV).
Cross-functional stakeholder management without a PM — high autonomy, high visibility.
 Green flags: No bureaucratic PM layer, clear ownership of business metrics, and a company with 15,000+ paying customers providing real production data to work with. The take-home case study hiring process signals they want proven builders, not credential collectors.
 Watch for: "We move fast" and "ambiguity doesn't slow you down" language suggests a high-intensity environment. This suits senior ICs but may be challenging if you prefer structured roadmaps.
Company Description
Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart — we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent , our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.
Your Role
ShareGate's customers generate rich signals (product usage, support interactions, renewal dates), but those signals aren't yet connected into an engine that protects and grows the revenue we already have. As our GTM Architect, Expansion & Retention, you'll design, build and ship AI agents and agentic workflows that turn those signals into saved renewals and cross-sell pipeline. This is an embedded engineering role within GTM, not back-office ops: you'll apply the signal-based, agent-first approach we already use for new customer acquisition to the customers we already have.
 Your impact: 
Protect renewals by building AI agents that continuously monitor renewal health and flag at‑risk accounts to Account Managers early, with context, recommended next steps and enough lead time to act.
Grow revenue from existing customers by designing and running an agentic cross‑sell motion: score fit for our second product line, research each account, personalize outreach, qualify interest and route genuine intent to the right salesperson with the full context needed to close.
Define the signals your agents need and partner with Revenue Systems, which builds and owns the data flow between product usage and the CRM. Validate the data with SQL before you act on it.
Replace manual workflows with AI agents and reusable pipeline modules (not one-off automations) that Account Management and Sales can run and own on their own.

az-ca-5961481766.description:
The Opportunity: 
We are looking for a delivery-focused Project Manager to run acquisition migrations end-to-end as Beacon standardizes each newly acquired company onto a common GTM stack. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who runs several projects at once against a hard deadline, keeps a lot of moving parts coordinated, and raises the bar on the quality of work around them.
Beacon acquires roughly one software company per week which is then integrated into our standardized GTM stack. This role partners with newly acquired companies starting from the first discovery call, through CRM and Support Ticketing builds, until systems are fully rolled out. This role coordinates internal resources and ensures the portfolio company is trained on the tech stack while adhering to an SLA and making the process more repeatable with every acquisition.
This role is responsible for running the project, meaning holding the timeline, managing the stakeholders, directing the build resources, and making sure what ships is right. This role will be partnered with a technical RevOps resource to help with deeper technical support, but this role will be responsible for speaking to the toolset at a high-level.
 What You Would Own: 
 Migration delivery. Acquisition migrations against our SLA, owned end to end: scoping, project planning, sequencing the CRM and Support Ticketing builds, coordinating data migration, and making sure the team is trained and confident at go-live. You would lead discovery calls to assess their current stack and map it to Beacon's standards, hold the plan and the timeline across several concurrent migrations, manage dependencies and risks before they become slips, and own the status.
 Contractor direction and quality. You would direct the work of pooled implementation contractors assigned to your migrations, pull in technical support when a problem genuinely needs it, make day-to-day scope and sequencing calls within the documented playbook, and escalate only genuine exceptions.
 Delivery process. Improving the migration playbook as you run against it — tightening the plan, the checklists, and the handoffs so each acquisition goes faster and more predictably than the last.
 Who You Are: 
 You have 3–5 years project or program management, running implementation, migration or change management projects — ideally in B2B SaaS, professional services, or consulting. You ideally have managed multiple projects concurrently against firm deadlines..
 You are literate in Go-To-Market systems. You understand how a CRM and a support platform are put together and can scope a build, and hold a credible conversation with a founder about their GTM tech stack.
 You have directed the work of others — contractors, an agency pod, or junior admins — even without formal people management.
 A confident stakeholder-facing communicator. You’re a people person who can understand hesitant stakeholders and help them feel excited during a period of a lot of change.
 Strong judgment under ambiguity. You make defensible calls from a playbook instead of escalating everything, and you know which exceptions genuinely warrant escalation.
 A quality bar you set rather than inherit. You care how the build looks six months after go-live, not just at handoff.
 Strong written communication. Much of this job is a clear status update landing in the right inbox at the right time
 A bias for action. You would rather move something forward than perfect the plan
 The agility to adapt when a program changes shape mid-stream, and the confidence to get hands-on when it needs you
 Nice to Have: 
Formal project management training or certification (PMP or similar).
Familiar with project management tools (Asana, JIRA, Monday.com).
Hands-on CRM experience (HubSpot, Salesforce, PipeDrive, Zoho, etc.)
Hands-on Support experience (Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, etc.)
M&A exposure, particularly post-close systems consolidation.
Familiarity with migration tooling or scripting that moves data faster and more reliably than manual imports allow.
 Our Values at Beacon Software 
Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time.
Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant.
Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected.
Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world - compounding growth.
 How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role. 
 AI does not make hiring decisions: Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

To plan, lead, and control the site operations as established in procedures and guidelines set by the company in the areas of: people, equipment, material and environmental safety, cost performance, asset utilization, customer product and service delivery

Dyno Nobel is a global leader in the commercial explosives industry. We provide innovative blasting solutions and quality explosives products throughout North America, Australia and selected customers in the Asia Pacific.
Join us in everything that’s great about Dyno Nobel: our culture, our values, our commitment to safety and most importantly our people. This combination makes Dyno Nobel a terrific place to work.

Escalon is a Toronto-based AI consultancy built by engineers. We help enterprises redesign their workflows around AI, then engineer, test and run those systems in production.
Our roots are in high-performance software, quality engineering and program delivery across gaming, SaaS and enterprise systems. That discipline is what makes AI hold up in the real world.
About the role
As a GTM Engineer you build the systems behind Escalon's growth: automated prospecting, lead enrichment and outreach workflows that put the right conversations in front of our team.
We are looking for a GTM operator who is also a hands-on builder. You understand how a revenue team works, you can turn its problems into working automations, and you have built those solutions yourself rather than only managing the tools and processes around them.
Our buyer and prospect signals live across a CRM, enrichment tools, outreach platforms, and public and third-party data. You will connect those sources, add context, and build workflows that show our team who to engage, why, when and with what message.
You do not need to be a traditional software engineer. You may come from revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, GTM systems or a similar technical GTM function. Because Escalon builds AI systems for clients, you will also be a first-hand user of the kind of AI workflows we recommend.
Clay CRM and workflow automation Lead enrichment Outreach tooling Data and integrations
What you'll do
Build prospecting and enrichment workflows: design and run automated account research, lead enrichment, scoring and prioritization that keep our pipeline full of the right companies and contacts.
Turn signals into action: connect and enrich data from the CRM, outreach tools, web activity and third-party sources to identify high-value accounts and recommend the next step.
Automate the GTM stack: build integrations and workflows across the CRM, Clay, sales engagement and outreach tools, enrichment providers and internal data sources.
Build agents and internal tools: use LLMs, APIs, webhooks, automation platforms and scripting to create tools that make our team faster and more effective.
Design outreach workflows: set up sequencing, personalization and follow-up, and keep them accurate, compliant with email and privacy rules, and well measured.
Prototype and iterate quickly: get solutions into users' hands, measure what works, and improve them from real feedback.
Make workflows reliable: add validation, guardrails, human review where it matters, monitoring and error handling so automations can be trusted in production.
Keep data clean: own data quality across tools so records, owners and statuses stay consistent as volume grows.
What you need
Experience in revenue operations, sales operations, GTM systems, marketing operations or a similar GTM function.
A solid understanding of B2B revenue workflows: lead management, routing, enrichment, qualification, account prioritization, prospecting and pipeline generation.
Hands-on experience building automations, integrations, internal tools or data workflows yourself.
Experience with GTM platforms such as Clay, a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce or similar), and outreach or sales engagement tools.
Experience building AI or LLM-powered workflows, with tools such as Claude, OpenAI, n8n, Zapier, Make or similar.
Comfort working with APIs, webhooks and scripting to connect systems.
The ability to work directly with the people who use your systems and translate their problems into working solutions.
Nice to have
Experience building account intelligence, scoring, routing or signal-based GTM workflows.
Experience taking an automation or AI workflow from prototype through production and adoption.

About Clutch
We’re on a mission to reinvent the way people buy, sell, and own cars.
Clutch is Canada’s largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car buying and selling experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee... and that’s just the beginning.
Named two years in a row to the Globe & Mail’s list of the Top Growing Companies in Canada and also awarded spots on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50TM and Fast 500TM lists, we’re looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.
Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017 and currently services Ontario, British Columbia, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, and Prince Edward Island. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including D1 Capital, Altos Ventures, BMO Capital Partners, Canaan, Real Ventures, and others. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.
About the role
We’re looking for a smart, resourceful, and analytically strong individual to join our Revenue team as Strategy and Operations Manager (Revenue). This role is an exceptional opportunity for someone early in their career 1-5 years post-grad who’s hungry to drive impact across a high-growth sales organization - working side by side with our VP of Sales on strategic initiatives, performance insights, and cross-functional projects that unlock growth.
What You’ll Do
Project-Based Execution
Lead and execute small to medium-sized strategic projects that drive incremental improvement across the sales team—ranging from process optimization to frontline tools to performance analysis.
Take ownership of project scoping, planning, execution, and results measurement—working across disciplines to see initiatives through end-to-end.
Ruthlessly prioritize initiatives that move the needle and align with broader revenue goals.
Work Cross-Functionally to Drive Change
Collaborate with Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Engineering to remove friction in the sales process and bring structure to ambiguity.
Be equally comfortable building a business case in Excel, presenting findings to the VP Sales, or jumping into a call with a distressed customer to understand root causes.
Translate complex problems into actionable insights—and ensure action happens.
Data-Driven Insights & Sales Strategy
Dive deep into sales and funnel data to uncover insights and opportunities. You’ll be expected to bring a strong analytical toolkit and be an 8+/10 when it comes to working with data.
Support forecasting, territory planning, performance dashboards, and root cause analysis to inform sales leadership decision-making.
Develop simple, clear, and persuasive recommendations backed by data and common sense.
Self-Learning & Experimentation
Take initiative to self-learn new tools, frameworks, and strategies—whether it’s mastering ChatGPT, learning how to write SQL, or figuring out how a new system works with minimal handholding.
Be proactive in experimenting with new ideas, rapidly testing assumptions, and applying learnings in real-time.
Develop comfort navigating ambiguity and unfamiliar territory—you’ll regularly tackle challenges that don’t come with a playbook.
What We’re Looking For
1-5 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, sales strategy, business operations, or a high-performing startup environment.
8+/10 with data: Strong proficiency with Excel/Sheets required; experience with SQL, BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau)
Proven ability to lead structured projects and think strategically, while also rolling up your sleeves to get things done.
Comfortable with ambiguity and change—able to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.
Intellectually curious, fast learner, and someone who brings strong judgment and common sense to every conversation.
Strong communication and collaboration skills—you’re just as comfortable with execs as you are with frontline staff or developers.
Gritty, humble, and high-agency: you take initiative, own problems, and don’t wait to be told what to do.
Nice to Have
A genuine interest in Clutch’s industry—automotive, marketplaces, consumer tech, or the future of retail.
Passion for building things from the ground up and a desire to grow into a leadership role in the future.
Why Clutch
Partner directly with the VP Sales on initiatives that materially impact top-line performance.
Solve meaningful problems, fast: You’ll be in the room where decisions happen and have the chance to influence direction across the business.
Build your career: Whether your goal is GM, Product, Strategy, or Ops—this role sets a strong foundation for growth.
Competitive package: Market cash, equity upside, full benefits, and a collaborative in-office culture built on pace and curiosity.

Existing, Permanent Full-Time

hc-ashby___keebler-health___c9c83ec2-502.description:
About the Role 
Keebler Health is building the operating system for value-based care. Our mission is to help risk-bearing healthcare organizations thrive in value-based arrangements by unlocking the full power of their data. We empower leading primary care groups, ACOs, and health plans to act on real-time insights that improve outcomes, reduce costs, and fuel sustainable growth.
We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to be the face of Keebler Health for our customers. You will own the relationship, act as the customer’s advocate inside our company, and make sure they see real value from the platform and want to grow with us. You will work closely with our Implementation team, who own the technical build, while you stay the person the customer knows and trusts from the late stages of the sale through go-live and the long-term partnership that follows.
This is a US-based remote position. We have a strong preference for candidates based in North Carolina or New York, where our team hubs are.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Customer Relationships 
Own the relationship for your portfolio of accounts, from late-stage sales through onboarding and ongoing partnership.
Join late-stage sales conversations to help set realistic expectations before contract signature.
Build trusted relationships with executive, clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders, and keep building them as people and priorities change.
Be the customer’s advocate inside Keebler Health, making sure their needs, feedback, and concerns reach Product, Engineering, and Clinical teams and get answered.
Understand each customer’s goals, challenges, and measures of success, and tell their story clearly to our internal teams.
Develop account plans, stakeholder maps, and communication rhythms for each account.
Lead regular business reviews, executive check-ins, and planning conversations.
Be a key part of renewals, and help customers get the most from their relationship with us by identifying additional features and opportunities that fit their goals.
Monitor account health and address risks, gaps, and opportunities before the customer has to raise them.
 Managing a Portfolio 
Balance competing priorities across several customers, deciding where your time and our team’s time will have the most impact.
Manage requests, issues, and escalations through to resolution, coordinating with Implementation, Support, Product, Engineering, and Clinical teams.
Set honest expectations with customers about timing and scope, and say no or not yet when you need to.
Keep commitments visible so that important details do not fall through the cracks.
Hold stakeholders, internal and external, accountable while maintaining strong working relationships.
 Working with Implementation 
Partner with the Implementation team through onboarding so the handoff to ongoing account management is smooth and nothing is lost.
Drive adoption across practices and user groups, including bringing on new users and sites over time.
Share structured customer feedback and contribute to repeatable customer success processes and playbooks.
 What Success Looks Like 
We're moving fast as a company, and things will change rapidly, but below is a sense of what success could look like in this role:
First 30 days: learn our platform, customers, and internal teams, and meet the stakeholders for your accounts as well as take ownership of steady state customers.
First 90 days: own your account portfolio, with account plans in place and your first quarterly business reviews completed.
First year: customers who are live and using the platform, clear measures of value, and renewals or expansions that reflect it.
 About You 
 Your Experience 
3-5+ years in customer success, account management, or another customer-facing role, ideally in software.
A track record of owning customer relationships and growing or renewing accounts, with measurable results.
Sales skills: you are comfortable running a commercial conversation, spotting an opening, and asking for the next step.
Credibility with senior customers and the confidence to have difficult conversations.
Strong organization and the ability to juggle competing priorities across several accounts without dropping the ball.
Ability to work with technical and non-technical teams without direct authority.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Comfortable working in an early-stage or rapidly changing environment.
Value-based care or healthcare technology experience is a nice to have, not a requirement. If you’re strong in the rest and curious about the industry, we want to hear from you.
 How You Work 
Takes ownership of outcomes and drives them forward independently.
Combines real empathy for the customer with operational discipline.
Stays calm and clear under pressure, including when a customer is unhappy.
Advocates for customers without losing sight of what is realistic for Keebler Health.
Communicates credibly with everyone from a clinician inside a practice to an executive inside a parent organization.
Motivated by compounding results, where the second year of an account is stronger because of how the first year was run.
Uses LLMs and AI tools to remove friction and build capacity, and improves the team’s systems alongside their own output.
 What We Offer 
Competitive salary, equity options, and benefits package.
A fast-paced, innovative environment.
Professional growth and development opportunities.
A collaborative and supportive team culture.
The chance to shape a foundational role and make a meaningful impact on the healthcare industry.

 What you'll do

 What you'll bring

Strong commercial judgment and communication skills

The ability to manage complex client relationships independently in a remote environment
German, French, or Spanish fluency is a plus.
Experience with SaaS, fintech, APIs, or payments is also helpful.
 You’ll thrive here if you 
Own outcomes without waiting for direction.
Keep complex implementations organized.
Stay calm and credible in difficult situations.
Balance customer needs with commercial judgment.
Enjoy building processes other people can use.
 What's cool about the role 
 Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role:
US: $160k to $240k.
UK: £100k - £150k
Spain: €85k - €140k
 Fully remote. Work from anywhere in Spain, the UK, or EST United States.
 Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook .

The Opportunity 
The Revenue Operations team at Euna Solutions is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to own the reporting, forecasting, and compensation numbers that go-to-market leaders use to run the business: bookings and attainment, win rates, pipeline health, retention, and the commission payouts calculated against them. You will be one of two analysts on this function, with clear coverage ownership and a direct line to leadership output reviewed by the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations. If you want to build deep expertise in a revenue analytics and compensation function with real visibility into how the business performs, this is the role for you.
 What You'll Do 
Own standing sales and Customer Success reporting: bookings versus plan, win rates, deal cycle trends, pipeline coverage, GRR, NRR, and churn, cut by segment, team, vertical, and solution
Answer the follow-up question behind every number: what changed, for whom, and what the gap is worth

Public sector or GovTech experience

hc-bamboohr___fintechos___483.description:
At FintechOS, we are looking for a Sales Operations Lead who wants to build, influence, and leave a visible mark. You will shape the processes, data, technology, and commercial rhythms behind our global enterprise sales organisation, creating an environment where the commercial team can focus, execute consistently, and thrive.
This is not a CRM administration role. You will have the mandate to challenge what is not working, simplify how we operate, and turn HubSpot into a genuine performance enabler. Your impact will be visible in seller productivity, pipeline quality, forecast confidence, and our ability to scale.
 Why this role is worth your next move 
• Build, do not simply maintain: shape the sales operating model and HubSpot environment for our next stage of growth.
• Influence at the right level: partner with senior commercial leaders on forecasting, planning, performance, and go-to-market decisions.
• Own outcomes end to end: identify the problem, design the solution, lead adoption, and measure the commercial impact.
• Solve meaningful complexity: enable enterprise sales into banks, insurers, and other highly regulated organisations.
The impact you will make
 Build the sales operating system: Create scalable processes and cadences that help sellers prioritise the right accounts, progress complex opportunities, and execute consistently.
 Make HubSpot work for sellers: Own CRM architecture, pipeline design, workflows, automation, integrations, reporting, data governance, and adoption.
 Increase seller productivity: Remove unnecessary administration, automate repetitive work, and return more time to customer-facing activity.
 Own the revenue execution cadence: Run pipeline inspection, deal reviews, forecast cadence, and the shared sales scoreboard, turning each into clear decisions, actions, and accountability.
 Turn data into decisions: Give sellers, managers, and leaders clear insight into priorities, risks, performance, and growth opportunities.
 Enable complex deals: Improve pricing, approvals, contracting, and cross-functional coordination across long enterprise sales cycles.
 Shape commercial planning: Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance on territories, quotas, capacity, coverage, and performance management.
 Lead meaningful change: Take operational improvements from idea through implementation, enablement, adoption, and measurable impact.
What you will bring
8+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Commercial Operations, ideally within enterprise B2B SaaS.
Advanced HubSpot experience across CRM architecture, pipeline design, automation, reporting, integrations, data governance, and user adoption.
Experience supporting long, high-value sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers, procurement, legal, security, and executive stakeholders.
Hands-on ownership of forecasting, pipeline governance, territory planning, quota setting, or capacity planning.
Strong knowledge of ARR, ACV, bookings, pipeline coverage, win rate, sales velocity, and quota attainment.
Strong analytical and modelling skills using Excel or Google Sheets, plus Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools.
A track record of simplifying sales processes and improving seller productivity without sacrificing commercial discipline.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
Great to have
Experience in fintech, banking technology, insurance technology, payments, or another regulated industry.
Familiarity with MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, Challenger, or another enterprise sales methodology.
Experience with Gong, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clari, or similar platforms.
Experience improving deal-desk, pricing, compensation, or partner-led sales processes.
You will know you are making an impact when
Sellers know where to focus and how to move opportunities forward.
HubSpot is valued as a selling tool, not treated as an administrative obligation.
Pipeline and forecast conversations are consistent, focused, and actionable.
Managers have the insight they need to coach effectively.
Commercial approvals and internal handoffs are faster and more predictable.
The sales operating model scales confidently with the business.
Who we are
FintechOS is a global fintech enablement company on a mission to make financial innovation accessible to every business. Our platform helps banks, insurers, and other financial institutions launch and scale financial products faster, bringing new solutions to market in as little as 12 weeks.
You will join an international team solving complex commercial and technology challenges in one of the world’s largest and most highly regulated industries. We value ownership, curiosity, collaboration, inclusion, and constructive challenge.

Hands-on leadership of complex enterprise software implementations, from solution design through go-live and support.
Experience recovering high-risk or underperforming customer programmes.
Experience bui

 Salesforce or HubSpot.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical, operational, and commercial complexity.
 What will set you apart 
You have led Customer Success for mission-critical enterprise platforms.

You build scalable systems without making strategic customers feel standardised.
You combine strategic thinking with the willingness to step directly into complex customer situations.
You challenge customers and internal teams constructively, using evidence and shared outcomes.
 How success will be measured 
 Retention: Customer health, GRR contribution, logo retention, and early visibility of renewal risks.

 Growth: Qualified expansion opportunities and NRR contribution.

 Why join FintechOS? 
This is an opportunity to shape a strategic function at the intersection of customer value, enterprise software delivery, product strategy, and recurring revenue growth .

 If you have led enterprise Customer Success in financial-services technology and enjoy combining strategy, commercial ownership, people leadership, and direct customer engagement, we would like to hear from you.

Leaders have reliable, consistent, and timely analytical visibility.

Recurring reporting becomes increasingly repeatable and less manually intensive.
Analytics surfaces meaningful trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities.
Business leaders can trace findings to trusted data and use them to make decisions.

About Us
Mighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events. Through its advanced technology, called people magic, Mighty helps the members of those networks build relationships with each other by surfacing the most relevant and interesting connections. 
Because of this novel approach and member-centered experience, Mighty has produced the most $1M communities and helped its Hosts earn over $500M.
The Role
At Mighty Networks, we believe communities are the next generation of digital business. As a Customer Success Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring our Mighty Pro Hosts achieve outstanding success. You will act as their primary partner, helping them unlock their community’s potential and exceed their goals through proactive engagement, strategic guidance, and ongoing relationship management. The ideal candidate is results-driven, strategic, and committed to ensuring our Hosts see measurable success.
What You'll Do
Serve as the primary relationship owner from the moment a Pro Host signs with Mighty through renewal and beyond, ensuring a seamless and positive experience throughout the customer lifecycle.
Develop and deliver custom quotes for additional services, aligning with Hosts' evolving needs and business objectives.
Partner with Mighty Pro Hosts to increase adoption of key product features that will lead to great engagement and retention within their community.
Map out a compelling success plan for each Mighty Pro Host, aiming to exceed their goals and deliver results beyond their initial expectations.
Proactively anticipate and plan for key moments and milestones in the annual life of a Mighty Pro Host, ensuring timely interventions and support.
Identify and mitigate risks to our long-term relationships with Mighty Pro Hosts, collaborating with cross-functional teams to address challenges promptly.
Creatively generate value by ensuring clear goals, key milestones, frequent check-ins, and Host and member satisfaction—capturing and sharing best practices from across our entire Customer Success function.
Communicate consistently and methodically with Mighty Pro Hosts and internal teams, including leadership, marketing, product, and customer advocacy, to ensure continuous improvement and scalability of Host results.
Own the renewal process from start to finish, proactively engaging Hosts well in advance of their renewal date, addressing concerns, demonstrating ongoing value, and securing long-term commitments.
What We're Looking For
Proven experience in Customer Success, with a track record of delivering exceptional results for clients.
Strong organizational and relationship-building skills, with the ability to manage complex client relationships and navigate challenging conversations effectively.
Experience managing high-value accounts, demonstrating the ability to help successful brands, entrepreneurs, and creators build incredible businesses through the power of community.
A proactive and dynamic approach, thriving in a fast-paced, rapidly growing environment, and constantly seeking ways to enhance impact and value creation.
Curiosity and active listening skills, with a passion for community-powered businesses and a desire to be part of building a new and critical team at a pioneering startup.
Confidence in executive communication, both with high-profile Hosts and internal leaders, ensuring clear and effective dialogue.
A desire to drive innovation, helping creators, entrepreneurs, and brands make the biggest impact in 2027 and beyond.
Ability to implement feedback loops to capture customer insights and inform product development and service enhancements.
An entrepreneurial mindset — you understand what it takes to build something from nothing, which gives you a natural empathy for the creators, entrepreneurs, and brands you'll serve.
A genuine curiosity about AI-driven solutions, consistently exploring how emerging tools can enhance customer outcomes, streamline your own workflows, and unlock new ways for community-powered businesses to grow and thrive.
What We Offer
A dynamic, remote-first work culture that values creativity, autonomy, and bold thinking.
Comprehensive benefits, including health, vision, dental, and paid time off.
Clear opportunities for professional growth, including leadership pathways and skill development support.
The chance to shape the future of how communities, creators, and brands thrive online—with the team that’s building what’s next.
Join us in shaping the future of community-driven digital businesses with Mighty Pro!
 Compensation: The base salary for this role ranges from $70,000–$125,000, with exact compensation based on location, experience, and cost of living.

Life at Plume 
 At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life’s moments better. Which is why we’ve built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. 
 We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We’re expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 
 With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can’t do it exceptionally well, we don’t do it. It’s how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it’s how we’re reinventing what’s possible every day. 
 The Opportunity 
 Plume is looking for a Technical Program Manager to join our Customer Experience organization, reporting directly to the VP of Customer Experience. This role sits at the intersection of technical delivery, program management, and customer success, acting as the connective tissue between our Product and engineering teams, and the Customer Success organization that supports our operator partners. You'll be the technical prime who ensures our solutions genuinely fit customer needs, the program lead who keeps cross-functional delivery on track, and the steady hand who guides the Customer Success team through change as new capabilities roll out.

 Own delivery of cross-functional programs supporting the Customer Success organization, coordinating stakeholders across product, engineering, and operations to keep scope, milestones, and resourcing on track. 
 Act as the technical prime for Customer Success, validating that product releases, configurations, and integrations genuinely fit each customer's environment and use case. 
 Lead change management as product and platform updates scale through the Customer Success team, including enablement materials, communication plans, and training so the team adopts new capabilities smoothly and confidently. 
 Serve as the technical intermediary between end customers and the Network Operations Center (NOC), triaging issues surfaced by customers, routing them to the right team, and ensuring timely resolution with clear communication back to all stakeholders. 
 Support core PMO functions for the Customer Experience organization: maintaining program trackers, status reporting, and risk/issue logs, and running the cadences that keep leadership informed. 
 Partner closely with the VP of Customer Experience to prioritize initiatives, flag risks early, and represent the voice of the customer in technical and delivery conversations. 
 Build strong working relationships across Customer Success, NOC, Engineering, and Product, so technical issues and program updates move quickly and don't get lost between teams. 
 Who You Are 
 A structured, detail-oriented operator who thrives at the intersection of technical depth and program management. 
 Comfortable translating between technical and non-technical audiences, from engineering and the NOC to Customer Success and executive leadership. 
 A natural bridge-builder who can guide a team through change and bring people along during transitions, not just announce them. 
 Calm and methodical under pressure when triaging live, customer-impacting technical issues. 
 Self-directed and comfortable juggling multiple concurrent initiatives with competing priorities and deadlines. 
 Genuinely curious about the product and the customer's experience of it, not just the process of shipping it.

Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research): 
 Team: Marketing 
 Prolific 
 Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision. 
 The role 
T his is a brand new role, and you’ll be the first person to do it at Prolific. 
 Right now, the insight that could help us win more deals is scattered. We have valuable learnings about why we win, why we lose, and why deals stall, but they aren’t turned into the pitch, proof and materials that sellers use every day. You’ll fix that. You’ll become the person who knows our market position inside out and turns it into tools that help sellers win. 
 This is a revenue role. It sits at the point where product marketing meets sales enablement, across both our AI and research businesses. You’ll dig into win-loss, competitive intelligence and customer proof, then turn it into pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, case studies and training that reps use on their next call. You’ll also help new AEs and SDRs get up to speed faster. 
 You’ll be measured on win rate, sales cycle length, rep ramp time and how well equipped our sellers are in front of a buyer. 
 Our AI PMM leads strategic lab and enterprise AI pursuits, and our vertical PMMs tailor messaging for specific audiences. You own the foundation they all build on: the shared, trusted system of resources every other deal runs on. 
 What you’ll bring to the role 
 6+ years in an enablement-facing role (product marketing, sales enablement or competitive intelligence) at a B2B company 
 Experience enabling sellers across more than one product or product line, at a startup, scale-up or enterprise 
 Experience doing the full job, not just the final slides: you’ve gathered the data and insight yourself, then turned it into materials sellers use 
 Enablement you’ve built that measurably moved win rate, ramp time or deal velocity. You can show who used it and what changed 
 Hands-on experience running buyer interviews. You ask about past behaviour, not hypothetical opinions, and you can get a lost buyer to tell you the real reason 
 Comfort with data: you can pull from a CRM and call-intelligence tools, build an analysis or business case, and defend your conclusions 
 Clear writing for busy readers: short, specific and easy to act on 
 Credibility with sellers and senior leaders, and the ability to get sales, product and customer success to act without managing any of them. You’ll spend a lot of time with sales 
 What you’ll be doing in the role 
 Build and own sales enablement across AI and research: onboarding, ongoing training and launch readiness (with the AI PMM), plus a single source of truth that reps actually use 
 Audit what exists today, decide what stays and what goes, and set up a way to keep it current 
 Build and maintain the core sales toolkit: pitch narrative, decks, one-pagers, discovery guides, battlecards, objection handling, white papers and business-case tools 
 Design and run our win-loss programme: buyer interviews after closed-won, closed-lost and no-decision outcomes, combined with CRM and call data and a regular readout to leadership. You’ll also run one outreach calendar for every AI buyer interview, including the AI PMM’s, so no buyer is asked twice 
 Own competitive intelligence against data labelling vendors, research panel providers and in-house alternatives, including a live view of competitor pricing and positioning that feeds the AI PMM’s category point of view 
 Turn findings into specific changes, such as a new talk track, a revised discovery question or a pricing recommendation, then check whether the change moved the number 
 Own customer proof: case studies with AI and research customers, a sourced library of proof points, the reference programme for live deals, and advocacy through quo
[...]
AI segment win rates the AI PMM is measured on. Work with RevOps to clean up CRM fields for loss reasons and competitor. 
 Why Prolific is a great place to work 
 We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. 
 We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity. 
 Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.
For pay transparency, the base salary range for this full-time role in San Francisco or New York is $170,000-$200,000 per annum and negotiable for other states.

Create compelling commercial materials, including sales decks, business cases, battlecards, and customer-facing resources that help teams communicate Frontify's value.
Maintain and improve our master commercial deck and content library, keeping materials accurate, consistent, and easy to access.
Help teams use AI-powered content creation tools and reusable templates to create high-quality materials more independently.
Collaborate with Product Marketing and Creative Studio to ensure commercial resources reflect Frontify's positioning, messaging, and brand.
Work in a hybrid setup, spending two days per week in our London office.
 What You Bring
3+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or creating commercial content within a sales enablement environment, ideally in B2B SaaS.
A solid understanding of the B2B sales cycle and how enablement helps teams improve their effectiveness and progress opportunities.
Experience contributing to sales enablement activities, from creating playbooks to supporting sales processes and best practices.
Strong commercial writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex ideas and customer challenges into clear, persuasive materials.
Experience collaborating with Sales, Customer Success, or other commercial teams to understand challenges and develop practical solutions.
A curious, analytical mindset, with the ability to turn customer conversations and commercial insights into actionable improvements.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage priorities, collaborate with stakeholders, and deliver quality work.
Confidence using presentation tools such as Pitch, PowerPoint, or Google Slides, alongside an interest in AI-powered content creation.
Familiarity with Gong, Clozd, MEDDIC, or similar enablement tools and sales methodologies is a plus.
 What We Offer
Private health benefits and health cash plan
Pension scheme: 5% matched
A minimum of 25 days of annual leave per year
Paid educational and wellbeing days off
Wellbeing, learning and development, and commuter allowance
Home office setup budget
Weekly free office lunch
Workation: Work from inspiring locations around the world (45 days annually)
Localized benefits
Invite to our summer company meet-up

Role Description
As a GTM Program Manager focused on the GTM organization, you will turn revenue-driving strategies into operational execution. You will play a crucial role in translating business priorities into the systems, processes, and business rules needed to bring new commercial initiatives to life and scale existing motions.
You will lead cross-functional planning, define business requirements, align stakeholders, and drive delivery with business and technical partners. Your work will connect teams across the customer lifecycle, ensure operational readiness, and measure whether implemented solutions achieve their intended business outcomes.
You will play a crucial part in helping the organization deliver on its growth strategy. You’ll build partnerships across GTM functions and see the direct impact of your work on revenue execution and the customer and seller experience.
 Responsibilities
Translate strategy into execution: Turn revenue-driving strategies into actionable plans across GTM systems, processes, and business rules.
Define business requirements: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, document requirements, and establish clear success criteria.
Lead cross-functional delivery: Manage programs from discovery through implementation, coordinating scope, timelines, dependencies, and accountable owners.
Drive solution development: Partner with business and technical teams to evaluate options, resolve gaps, and implement scalable solutions.
Align stakeholders and decisions: Facilitate discussions, clarify tradeoffs, and drive agreement on priorities, ownership, and outstanding decisions.
Ensure operational readiness: Coordinate testing, documentation, and change management to support successful launches and adoption.
Measure outcomes and improve: Track results against business objectives, identify operational gaps, and drive improvements to execution and the customer and seller experience.
 Requirements
At least 3 years of overall professional experience.
3+ years of experience in Product Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Systems, or another role supporting complex cross-functional GTM initiatives.
Experience working in a B2B SaaS or subscription-based business with multiple products, customer segments, or routes to market.
Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, process workflows, and measurable success criteria.
Experience partnering with technical and business teams to evaluate solutions, assess tradeoffs, and validate that changes meet business needs.
Ability to identify root causes, use data to assess outcomes, and implement practical improvements that scale.
Strong systems thinking, with the ability to understand how a change in one part of the commercial lifecycle can affect downstream processes, systems, data, and customer experiences.
 Preferred Qualifications

 Skills

li-4487834628.description:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.
Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.
As our Compensation Manager, you will own how Profound pays and motivates its go-to-market team. Sitting within GTM Operations, you will partner with Sales and Post-Sales leadership to design incentive plans that drive the right behavior, and you will run the comp engine behind them: calculations, systems, and payouts. You will work very closely with our Payroll team so every rep is paid accurately and on time, and with Finance so plans are modeled, budgeted, and accounted for correctly. This is a 0-to-1 role: you will build the comp function's systems, processes, and controls as our GTM team scales.
 What You’ll Do
 Incentive design
Own incentive plan design across GTM roles, including Account Executives, SDRs, Account Managers, Engagement Managers, and other Post-Sales and Sales roles
Partner with Sales and Post-Sales leadership to translate GTM strategy (new logo, expansion, retention) into plan mechanics: pay mix, rates, accelerators, ramps, and SPIFs
Partner with GTM Ops on quota setting, capacity, and territory alignment so targets, coverage, and plans fit together each planning cycle
Partner with Finance to model plan cost, attainment scenarios, and earnings distribution, and to keep comp within budget
 Comp operations and payouts
Run the commissions cycle end to end: crediting, calculations, review, approvals, and payout
Partner very closely with Payroll on payout files, timing, and reconciliation so commissions and SPIFs are paid accurately and on schedule
Own plan documents, participant acknowledgments, and the comp calendar
Communicate plans and changes to the field clearly and simply, and be the go-to resource for comp questions
Run a consistent process for inquiries, disputes, and exceptions, and flag recurring exceptions as plan-design issues rather than one-off fixes
 Systems, reporting, and compliance
Build and own our comp systems, including selecting, implementing, and administering a commission platform integrated with Salesforce, HRIS, and payroll
Partner with Revenue Systems and GTM Engineering to keep bookings, roster, and crediting data clean and in sync across systems
Build reporting and dashboards on attainment, payout cost, and plan effectiveness for reps, leaders, and Finance
Partner with Accounting on monthly commission accruals, with documentation and controls that hold up to audit
Use AI and automation to remove manual work, such as data validation, discrepancy checks, and payout estimates for reps
 Who you are
3 to 5+ years of experience in sales compensation, GTM or revenue operations, or FP&A, with hands-on ownership of both plan design and comp operations
Deep understanding of incentive mechanics, including quotas, accelerators, ramps, draws, clawbacks, and SPIFs, across both new business and post-sales roles
Strong Salesforce knowledge, especially how opportunity and booking data flows into commission calculations
Track record partnering with Payroll and Finance to deliver accurate, on-time payouts and clean month-end close
Highly analytical, with advanced Excel or Sheets modeling skills; SQL experience is a plus, not required
A natural business partner who builds trust quickly with sales leaders and reps and can explain comp mechanics simply
Exceptional attention to detail and sound judgment handling confidential pay data
Thrives in ambiguity with a 0-to-1 mindset, and is energized by building structure, processes, and tools where none exist yet
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI assistants or automation tools to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy
 Nice to have
Experience standing up a comp function or commission platform at a fast-growing, early-stage SaaS or AI company
Experience with HRIS and payroll integrations, and with multi-country or international comp plans
 Location
 NYC preferred; remote or other locations (SF, Boston, London) considered. This role is for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.
For this role, the expected base salary range is $200,000 to $220,000 (US) and £100,000 to £140,000 (UK). Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.
Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.
 Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.
 About The Sales Operations Team
 The Sales Operations team helps Thumbtack’s sales and account management teams grow revenue. We build the programs and tools that help reps bring local service businesses onto Thumbtack and grow strategic existing accounts. The work spans acquisition and account management, with close partners in Product, Marketing, Data Science, Enablement, and QA.
 About The Role
 You’ll drive Thumbtack’s sales strategy and partner closely with the Sales leadership team to execute it. Your focus is growing sales revenue by bringing more pros onto Thumbtack and expanding relationships with existing accounts.
Reporting to the Vice President of Commercial Operations, you’ll lead analysts and managers across North America and the Philippines. There’s room to build new approaches to outbound prospecting, account expansion, and the use of AI in sales. You’ll get close to the data and frontline work yourself, then turn what you learn into programs and strategic levers that’ll deliver impact.
 What You’ll Do
Drive the sales strategy to grow revenue, partnering closely with Sales leadership to set priorities and execute against shared goals.
Build new approaches to outbound acquisition and existing account expansion. Test them in the field and scale what works.
Get into the data and spend time with reps and pros to understand where there’s opportunities to maximize sales and pro lifetime value. Turn those findings into changes that improve conversion and account growth.
Use AI to build better prospecting, selling, and account management workflows. Measure whether reps use them and whether they increase revenue or productivity.
Get agreement on priorities and ownership with Product, Marketing, Data Science, and sales technology partners. Resolve dependencies that hold up execution.
Keep core sales operations running well, including lead routing, account management workflows, and sales tools, so reps can spend more time selling.
Develop the managers on your team and give them clear ownership. Make hiring and performance decisions that build the team’s ability to deliver.
 In order to be successful, you must bring
Experience developing and executing sales or commercial strategy, with clear evidence of revenue growth. High-volume sales to small businesses is especially relevant; management consulting experience is a plus.
The analytical depth to investigate a problem yourself. You question metric definitions, check the underlying data, and test whether your diagnosis holds up.
Experience building a new sales motion, team, or operating capability from an unclear starting point. You’ve done the work to get it adopted and can show what impact that created.
Experience leading managers and developing people. You set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and make difficult decisions when the team needs them.
Clear communication and sound judgment with partners. You can challenge a senior stakeholder’s assumptions with data and evidence, understand your partner’s differing view and drive impact with speed.
Curiosity and urgency. You learn unfamiliar areas quickly and are willing to try a different approach. You can make a call with imperfect information and adjust as you learn.

The Opportunity
Euna Solutions is hiring a Go-to-Market Intelligence Analyst to own the account and contact intelligence layer that tells our sellers which public sector agencies to pursue and when. You will build and refine the scoring models, data standards, segmentation logic, and competitive intelligence that drive how Euna targets and wins in the government market. If you want your analytical work to shape real commercial decisions rather than land in a deck, this is the role for you.
What You'll Do
Own Intent-to-Buy and Propensity-to-Buy scoring models across solutions and segments, including inputs, logic, validation against closed outcomes, and ongoing recalibration
Bring public sector signal sources, including procurement activity, grant awards, and audit and compliance data, into the scoring models and test whether each one predicts conversion
Define and enforce account and contact data standards for prospect and target accounts, driving remediation with GTM Systems rather than stopping at the report
Analyze win rate, sales cycle, churn, and expansion patterns by segment and vertical to sharpen the ICP and translate findings into targeting rules the field can execute
Own competitive intelligence across segments and solutions, including win/loss patterns and FOIA-sourced commercial insight
Partner with Sales, BD, and Marketing to operationalize scoring and segmentation into territory views, prioritized target lists, and outbound workflows
What You Bring
You have 4+ years in go-to-market analytics, revenue operations, market intelligence, or a comparable analytical function
You have built, maintained, or evaluated an account or propensity scoring model and can speak to how it was validated and what you changed based on evidence
You bring strong Salesforce capability, including reporting and a working understanding of the account, contact, and opportunity data model
You are fluent in advanced Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with large, messy, multi-source datasets
You can explain a model's logic, its limits, and its results clearly to non-technical sellers and leaders
 Nice-to-Have Qualifications
Familiarity with public sector procurement cycles, budget data, or the GovTech market
Experience managing enrichment or intent data vendor relationships, including ingestion logic and refresh cadence
Hands-on experience with SQL and one or more BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
Practical use of AI tooling for research, enrichment, or unstructured data analysis
Location
This position will be hybrid with 3 days/week in our[Oakville, ON office.
Compensation Range: $88,000-$110,000
We believe in openness, so we publish our range from the start. Where an offer will land depends on your background, strengths, and how you'll contribute to the work ahead.
This role fills an existing vacancy. Euna uses AI responsibly to assist in screening, assessing, or selecting applicants. AI helps us work smarter, but people lead the process.

We believe the future of work is human + AI. At Euna Solutions, we encourage our team members to leverage AI tools to enhance creativity, efficiency, and decision-making. We're looking for people who are curious about emerging technologies, eager to experiment, and committed to using AI responsibly to augment, not replace, their expertise.
If you enjoy exploring new ways to solve problems, learning continuously, and applying AI to make your work smarter and more impactful, you'll thrive here.
Life at Euna Solutions
We're a team of builders, problem-solvers, and public sector champions. We've built a workplace around a straightforward idea: people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and not running on empty.
 Here's What That Actually Looks Like

We're hybrid — three days a week in our Oakville or Atlanta offices, with standard hours on those days. What the remaining days look like depends on your role and your manager. We talk about it early in the process so there are no surprises on either side.

Twice a year, you get an extra day tacked onto a long weekend. We think recharging is part of doing good w

ions. Euna's AI-powered features and intelligent automation help organizations make better-informed decisions, ensure compliance, empower collaboration, and reduce administrative burden. We are looking for a strategic and technically skilled GTM Strategy and Operations Manager to strengthen the commercial infrastructure supporting the full customer lifecycle, from pipeline creation through renewal and expansion. In this remote role, you will combine advanced analytics, revenue operations, and AI-driven automation to improve forecasting, sales execution, and business visibility. You will own key commercial systems and processes, including Salesforce opportunity management and Clari forecasting, while building reliable reporting and intelligent workflows. Working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Finance, and executive stakeholders, you will turn complex data into actionable recommendations. You will also identify opportunities to streamline operations, improve productivity, and strengthen recurring-revenue performance. This is an opportunity to shape scalable GTM systems and influence strategic decisions in a B2B technology environment.

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.
We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.
We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.
 About The Role
 Read more about what we’re building here .
We're looking for someone to supercharge our commercial operations. We're continually scaling our product across new markets and new clients, and we want to go even faster.
This is a wide-ranging role that'll require you to move at speed across diverse topics; in return, you'll gain high levels of ownership and exposure. Example topics include:
﻿﻿Entering new markets, from research & analysis to planning & delivery
﻿﻿Helping our new and existing clients get the most out of our software
Exploring and delivering on opportunities for growth in new verticals and customer segments
This is a high-velocity, high-impact role. To succeed, you'll need to learn quickly, and absorb & process highly technical information. You'll need to be strong with data, and have a 'run through walls' attitude to overcome the inevitable barriers.
 What's In It For You
 A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).
We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.
Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.
Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.
Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.
The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.
We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

We're looking for a commercially driven Go-To-Market leader to own how Treatwell takes its products to market across Europe. Working closely with our sales teams and leaders, and with Product, you'll turn our roadmap into revenue, with a particular focus on growing our financial services product line.
At Treatwell we don't just sell software: we help Europe's best salons and spas digitalise their business, grow their revenue and improve the experience they offer their clients.
You'll be the strategic owner of go-to-market for Treatwell across Europe. With a strong commercial mindset and a highly collaborative approach, you'll define how we position, price, package and launch our products, and partner with Sales to turn them into real, measurable revenue.
 You Will Be Responsible For
Commercial go-to-market strategy: Own and lead Treatwell's European go-to-market strategy, defining target segments, positioning, pricing, packaging and commercial priorities, with a clear focus on revenue growth.
Financial services revenue: Own and lead projects that drive revenue for the financial services product line, from payments to new financial solutions, setting clear targets and taking accountability for results.
Sales partnership: Work closely with our sales teams and sales leaders across markets to shape commercial plans and targets, and turn go-to-market strategy into pipeline, deals and revenue.
Sales enablement & playbooks: Build scalable playbooks, pricing guidance, sales narratives and training that help local market teams sell our products and drive adoption on the ground.
Product launches: Partner with Product to bring new products and features to market, from validation and pilots through to full European rollout, bringing the commercial and customer perspective into the roadmap.
Product-led growth: Alongside our sales teams, build in-app and self-serve sales motions that help adoption and revenue scale efficiently.
Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Supply, Finance, Operations, Legal and local market teams to embed payments into acquisition, onboarding, account management and retention.
Strategy into execution: Translate strategy into clear execution plans with owners, timelines and KPIs, proactively removing blockers and driving accountability across teams that don't report directly into the role.
Commercial performance & optimisation: Track and drive adoption, revenue and margin across markets, using data and customer insight to optimise pricing, packaging and the sales funnel.
Stripe partnership: Manage Treatwell's strategic partnership with Stripe, acting as the senior commercial point of contact and aligning joint go-to-market plans and growth priorities.
 About You
Proven experience in go-to-market, commercial strategy or sales strategy roles within a fast-growing digital or tech company (marketplaces, SaaS, delivery, fintech or similar)
Strong commercial focus, with a track record of owning revenue targets and driving measurable growth
Multi-market experience is a must: you've worked closely with sales teams and sales leadership across multiple markets
Experience leading commercial strategy across multiple markets, ideally in a central or group-level role
Strong analytical skills and confidence building business cases, commercial models and senior leadership updates
Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence and drive accountability without direct authority
Exposure to payments, fintech or embedded finance products is a plus
 About Treatwell
 We're a team of 800+ people working every day to transform the beauty industry across Europe. We've built the leading salon management software, connected to Europe's number one marketplace, helping thousands of professionals run and grow their business.
 The Numbers Speak For Themselves
Over 95,000 partner salons
Present in 14 countries
More than 23.5 million bookings every year
And the best is yet to come. If you want to join an international, innovative and fast-growing company where your work has a real, visible impact... join us!
 We'll Treat You With
 💰Compensation: A competitive base salary and bonus package.
🌍Location & flexibility: Based in London, Milan or Amsterdam, working closely with teams across all our European markets.
💻Work tools: All the tools and technology you need to do your best work.
🚀Impact: A rare opportunity to build and own a new growth engine for Treatwell from the ground up.
 Salary : €90K - €140K (depending on experience)
 Equal opportunities
 At Treatwell we're committed every day to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace, built on mutual respect and valuing everyone's uniqueness. We offer equal opportunities to all our candidates and employees, without any form of discrimination.

 At Poppulo, we help the world’s leading organizations reach every employee, wherever they work. 
For a large, distributed workforce, that’s harder than it sounds. Today’s workforce is spread across offices, factories, retail stores, hospitals and other frontline locations. No single communication channel can reach everyone. Poppulo brings those channels together in one AI-powered employee experience platform, helping companies deliver relevant communications wherever their people are located. 
More than 10,000 organizations trust us to connect with their workforce across email, mobile, intranet, Microsoft Teams, and digital signage. Our communications reach more than 50 million employees worldwide, and the platform delivers content to more than 600,000 digital signs around the globe.
